identified_during: Independent Behold/free-route review and Sidisi proposal audit before card authoring

primary_rules_interpretation.author: Nathan Long, Magic Rules NetRep
primary_rules_interpretation.summary: A zero mana cost requires acknowledgment but no mana payment, so casting Mox Opal does not grant a mana-ability opportunity. This interpretation is corroborated against the pinned current CR, not treated as a new2026 ruling.

concrete_risks: Zero/free/reduced spell and activation payment menus can offer illegal mana actions.
Speculative mana search can incorrectly create a missing Behold/sacrifice witness even when the casting or activation has no mana-payment window.
A positive total remains a mana payment even if Convoke/Delve later pay all of it; effect/hybrid alternatives need their actual positive choice preserved.
ownership: a-g owns shared FundingGoal final-total predicate/action+proposal enforcement; s-z narrow Sidisi guard will compose with or yield to it at integration.
planned_proofs: Actual supported zero-cost physical spell and ordinary Priority mana availability.
Filtered free Dragon casting and zero reduced Equipment activation.
Nonmana witness cannot be invented through a closed mana window; actual prior Priority setup remains legal.
status: Audited, unimplemented/unvalidated; root adds this81st dependency rather than claiming the original80 audit groups exhaust all interactions.
